pada: .input {$pada :integer select=ordinal} .input {$nakshatra :entity kind=nakshatra} .match $pada 1 {{{$nakshatra}nakṣatrasya prathamapāde nāmākṣaraṃ {$syllable}}} 2 {{{$nakshatra}nakṣatrasya dvitīyapāde nāmākṣaraṃ {$syllable}}} 3 {{{$nakshatra}nakṣatrasya tṛtīyapāde nāmākṣaraṃ {$syllable}}} 4 {{{$nakshatra}nakṣatrasya caturthapāde nāmākṣaraṃ {$syllable}}} * {{{$nakshatra}nakṣatrasya {$pada}tamapāde nāmākṣaraṃ {$syllable}}}
by: .input {$by :string} .match $by CELL {{pādasya svākṣaram}} PAIRED {{yugmarūpeṇa paṭhitam akṣaram}} SUBSTITUTE {{pratinidhyakṣaram}} * {{pādākṣaram}}
counted: .input {$counted :string} .match $counted SOUNDED {{likhitānusāraṃ gaṇitam, antyākārasahitam}} SILENT {{uccāraṇānusāraṃ gaṇitam, antyākāraṃ vinā}} * {{svarānusāraṃ gaṇitam}}
clause: .input {$clause :string} .match $clause SONANT_INITIAL {{ghoṣavadādi}} SEMIVOWEL_WITHIN {{prathamavarṇāt param antaḥsthayuktam}} VISARGA_FINAL {{visargāntam}} TWO_OR_FOUR_SYLLABLES {{dvyakṣaraṃ caturakṣaraṃ vā}} EVEN_FOR_A_BOY {{puṃso yugmākṣaram}} ODD_FOR_A_GIRL {{striyā ayugmākṣaram}} LONG_A_FOR_A_GIRL {{striyā ākārāntam}} NO_FINAL_L_OR_R {{na lāntaṃ na rāntam}} * {{anyo niyamaḥ}}
